summary: Legs A day, so extra sweet potato at lunch and dinner for carbs. No wellness-bar protein smoothie on today's menu, so pre-workout uses an Evolve shake plus half a bagel and a banana. Lunch centers on winter squash chicken creole (new main), and dinner brings in beef tacos for protein variety after a week of mostly chicken, with extra chicken breast layered in for protein.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Eggs and turkey for protein, oats and multigrain bread for steady carbs, banana for fiber and quick sugar.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Winter squash chicken creole (new this week) as the main, extra chicken breast, a double portion of wild rice, sweet potato and black beans round out leg-day protein and carbs.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat Evolve shake (no wellness smoothie today) plus half a bagel and a banana for easily digestible carbs before lifting.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Beef tacos for protein-source variety on a leg day, a double portion of extra chicken breast and sweet potato close out protein and post-lift carbs.

items.name: Beef Tacos, Cilantro, Onion, Avocado Salsa
